item.title: Sacramento Kings' Keon Ellis has a lot of intrigue ahead of trade deadline
item.description: John Fanta and Grant Liffmann analyze if the Sacramento Kings may struggle to move on from players like Zach LaVine and Domantas Sabonis, but highlight Keon Ellis' trade demand for some.

item.title: Jazz appear to be standing pat at trade deadline with eyes to next season
item.description: John Fanta and Grant Liffmann break down the "skepticism" around Lauri Markkanen's future with the Utah Jazz and why it feels like they can build for next season with the players they have.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo trade destinations: Trade rumors, possible packages, landing spots including Warriors, Knicks
item.description: Golden State will be in the mix trying to pair Antetokounmpo and Curry, but is there a trade that works for both sides?

item.title: LeBron James emotional after Cleveland tribute video, could he return home for one more season?
item.description: There has been plenty of speculation that LeBron could return for one more season with Cleveland.
